subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: What default chat-visible policy should OpenClaw use for tool failure reasons and same-turn retry recovery, especially across trusted operator chats versus external-recipient channels?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the safe behavior depends on maintainer intent for redaction, channel trust, noise, and duplicate-side-effect risk rather than a purely mechanical code fix.

options.title: Adopt safe summaries
options.body: Show allowlisted or redacted failure reasons and a recovered-before-final status when the same failed action is later resolved, with tests for compact and verbose modes.

options.title: Keep compact defaults
options.body: Keep the current compact warnings by default and rely on verbose mode or messages.suppressToolErrors for operators who need different privacy/noise tradeoffs.

options.title: Defer to native recovery
options.body: Treat this issue as dependent on the broader native tool-recovery design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85914 before changing visible warning semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt safe summaries
recommendation.body: Show allowlisted or redacted failure reasons and a recovered-before-final status when the same failed action is later resolved, with tests for compact and verbose modes.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blame and nearby refactor history put the warning formatter and lastToolError handling under this recent area owner, and the unresolved choice is a core security/product policy call.
